name: windy-plugin-passage-plan
description: Passage plan aid for ships on Windy.com: route editor, ETA, ship positions, weather along route and IMO MSC.1/Circ.1228 checks. Aid only, not ECDIS.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
scripts.harness: mkdir -p harness/dist && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css harness/index.html harness/dist/ && rollup -c harness/rollup.config.js
scripts.test:screens: npm run harness && node harness/run.cjs harness/shots
scripts.test:phone: npm run harness && node harness/phone.cjs harness/phone-shots

author: Capt. Node Central
